h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Motihari

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Motihari

items.pText: Motihari, the headquarters of East Champaran in north Bihar, has a growing number of private schools and residential colonies, and many of them are buying playground equipment for the first time. If you have never ordered from a manufacturer before, the process can seem unclear. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory in Maharashtra, about 1,470 km away, and we keep the process simple.

You deal with one contact at FunPlay from the first call to the installation. You can reach our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 or at sales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Below is what happens after you get in touch with us, step by step.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

items: Share the length and width of your site, the age group of the children and a few photos.
We suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.
You approve the layout and the quote, or ask for changes.
We manufacture the equipment at our Vasai factory and dispatch it by road.
Our team or a dealer in eastern India installs it, grouted or self-standing.

c: North Bihar's plains get heavy monsoon rain, so mention if your ground holds water and we will plan a raised base. Popular first choices include

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,470 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What information do you need to prepare a quote?
items.a: The site's length and width, the age group of the children and a few photos. With these we prepare a layout drawing and a quote.

items.q: Can you install playground equipment in Motihari?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India. Nearby towns in East Champaran are covered the same way.

items.q: What warranty comes with the equipment?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, covering manufacturing defects.
